notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
♫ FRESH DAY FRESH PATCH ♫

Just a small patch to fix a few issues and tweak some balancing. Full notes below, let us know if you find any problems.

Discord: https://discord.gg/QF9qyp

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32705960/31cd0c7d9fbc21624eb7a583d13de28c7681219b.png

Changelist

 fix: ship disappearing issue
 fix: ship stops turning issue
 fix: coin deletion rare errors
 fix: bear sleep zzz particles not showing
 fix: bullet hell honey pickup sfx not playing
 balance: magnet bandit pull amount reduced
 balance: magnet bandit pull start delay increased
 balance: honeypot time reward reduced slightly
 balance: difficulty increase slightly more at high score values
 balance: damage time penalty increase as time goes on
 balance: reduce haptics for wmr/oculus
 justice: released bear hostages



BEAR OUT
